clips.notes: light on his feet: rises onto his toes twice (a happy little bounce), weight L -> R, looks round (left, up at the sky, right) with the head leading and the chest late, the left hand once smooths the coat on his chest; bright blinks; coat panels swing

jaw in an irregular syllable rhythm (lip sync overrides it); nods on the stressed syllables; the right hand opens palm-up toward the listener in the first phrase, both hands spread a little in the second; weight shift; two blinks
light young walk, ~112 steps/min: springy hip bob, chest counter-turn, arms swing with lagging forearms, head steady with a small nod per step; coat panels swing late
eager run to his father: leaning forward, both arms out wide and forward (ready to hug), a flight phase with a bounce on every step, head up and beaming; coat / collar bounce
led away: slow heavy steps, head down, shoulders forward, wrists together low in front (as if tied); a look back over the shoulder once per two steps... (small), slow blinks

dips, then spins once on his toes to show the coat, arms out (palms up), the coat panels flaring out and catching up late; lands softly facing front with the arms open and a proud little chin-up; holds. The root bone turns 360 deg about Y (no translation), like ruth_joy
clips.rootSpin: root bone turns 360 deg about Y between f 9 and f 40 (no translation)

clips.notes: acts the dream out, eager: ties a bundle (the hands circle round each other in front of his belly, then pull the knot tight with a jerk), then both hands go up flat like standing sheaves and bow forward twice (wrists fold, the head bows with them), a bounce on the toes; jaw talks throughout (lip sync overrides it)

pushed: the body recoils, a stumbling step back with the arms flung up, he drops down to sit on the floor of the well (knees up, it is narrow), looks round scared, then reaches one arm (right) up high toward the rim, the other hand on the ground; holds reaching. Fits inside the well's 0.07 radius at the PIT mark

a servant at work: walks carrying a (mimed) water jar on his right shoulder, the right hand up by his ear steadying it, elbow out, head tilted away from it; the left arm swings; steady honest steps with a dip under the weight; no prop (the jar is the pose)

sits down on the cell's bench behind him (top h 0.062, front edge 0.025 behind his mark), leans forward with the elbows on his knees and the hands loosely together, head hanging; a sigh; then he lifts his head and looks up (trusting); holds

humble before the king: right hand to his chest, a respectful bow from the waist; then he straightens and lifts the right hand high to point up to heaven, the head following it up; the left hand open at his side; holds pointing

a kind teacher: counts on his fingers (the right hand taps three fingers of the open left hand, a nod on each), then opens both palms out to the listener, then brings them back; jaw talks (lip sync overrides it)

straightens up tall (a breath that lifts the chest), the right hand touches the new collar, chin up and a look out over the land (head turns to his left); the hand settles back down, the left hand at his belt; holds, standing tall

a small start (shoulders up, head back), the right hand to his chest; then he turns half away (hips, chest, head, in that order) and lowers his head so his brother cannot see his face; holds turned away, breathing hard
hands clasped at his chest, leaning in a little toward the listener, head tilted, small soft nods; the hands squeeze once; jaw moves a little (lip sync overrides it)

the dam breaks: a breath in, both hands go up to the striped head-cloth, lift it up and off (the `nemes` bone rises with the hands; marker `off` = the frame the cloth leaves the head: hide joseph/nemes there), then the arms open wide, palms out ('it's me!'), chest open, head up; holds with arms open, breathing

bends down over his brother sitting on the ground 0.115 in front, takes both his hands (grip at f 36) and raises him to his feet, leaning back a little as he pulls; ends holding his hands at chest height. Pair: brother_stand_up must start 24 f (0.8 s) after this clip, as story S10 has it

a long hug of someone 0.11-0.12 in front (fitted at 0.115; probed with brother_hug and jacob_hug): leans in, both arms round the partner's back under his arms, head to his own right against the partner's shoulder; rocking side to side (same phase as the partner's hug), one squeeze and a pat; eyes closed, happy tears

a big happy wave to the viewer: the right arm high above the head sweeping wide side to side, the wrist flapping late; bouncing on his toes, the left hand on his hip, the head tilting with the wave, beaming

an old father at ease: both hands stacked on the stick planted in front of him, leaning on it; slow deep breathing, a gentle side-to-side sway, looks fondly round (left, then right) and smiles, one contented nod; slow blinks; the shawl settles

talks warmly: right hand on the stick at his side, the left hand gestures palm-up on the stressed syllables and once comes to his chest; head nods and tilts; jaw in an irregular rhythm with pauses (lip sync overrides it); a chuckle in the shoulders

holds both arms out in front, the forearms up as if a folded coat lies across them (the right fist still holds the stick, lifted upright), a proud chuckle; then the left hand pats the shoulder of the son 0.12 in front (twice) and the stick goes back down beside him; holds smiling

quiet grief: the head bowed into his left hand (palm over the eyes, the mouth and beard still seen from the front), shoulders shaking in uneven sobs, the knees give a little on each; the right hand leans on the stick at his side; a slow shake of the head

slow old walk, stooped: short steps with a dip on each, the head nods late; the stick is lifted and set down every other step (planted with the left foot, so it stays still on the page while it carries weight); the free left arm hangs and swings a little; the shawl bounces

holds his son 0.11-0.12 in front (fitted at 0.115, probed with joseph_hug): the left arm round his waist, the stick still planted at his right side, his head beside his son's (to his own right), cheek on the shoulder; rocks with him (same phase), a squeeze, laughing-crying sobs in the shoulders; eyes shut

heavy and sure of himself: thumbs hooked in his belt, weight sinking onto one hip and then the other, chest out, a slow look round with the chin up, a sniff (head jerks up a little), a scratch of the beard with the right hand; slow blinks; the bag swings
talks bluntly: jaw in an irregular rhythm (lip sync overrides it), head jutting on the stressed syllables, the right hand chops the air, the left thumb in the belt; weight shift
heavy, swaggering walk: big hip roll, shoulders swinging against it, arms swinging wide from the body, chin up; feet land flat and heavy; the bag swings
a 'hmph': chest out, folds his arms high on his chest (right over left), shifts his weight onto one hip and turns his head away with the chin up; holds (sulking, slow breath)

muttering to himself, arms folded: the jaw grumbles (lip sync overrides it), head shakes, a shrug, then he kicks a pebble with the right foot (wind-up, kick, the foot comes back down to its mark) and sulks

outraged: a sharp breath back, then steps in and jabs his right arm straight at the listener (fist with the arm out: pointing), leaning in, chin forward, the left fist clenched at his side; two smaller jabs; holds pointing

lunges, grabs the coat at the shoulders of the brother 0.11 in front with both hands (f 16) and yanks it back toward his own chest (marker `off` at f 24 = hide joseph/coat), staggering back a step with it; ends clutching the (now hidden) coat at his chest, triumphant and sour

holds out the right palm (fx coins_spray there), the coins land (a little dip of the hand, f 22), the fist closes (f 30) and goes to his chest, the left hand rubs the beard, a greedy sideways glance and a smirk; holds

humbled: a tired breath, kneels (both knees on the page, a little behind his mark), sits back toward his heels and bows the chest and head low, hands flat on the page in front; holds bowed, breathing. Keep the person he bows to >= 0.11 in front (head clearance)
from bow_low: jerks up in shock (eyes wide), then falls back onto his bottom behind his mark, catching himself on both hands, knees up; trembles; holds sitting (stand_up starts from this pose)

from sitting (fall_back_scared): reaches both hands up to his brother 0.115 in front, is gripped (f 12) and pulled up onto his feet, the body coming forward over the feet; ends standing, holding hands, head a little bowed. Pair: joseph_lift_up starts 24 f earlier

hugs his brother 0.11-0.12 in front (fitted at 0.115, probed with joseph_hug): stoops to him, both arms over his shoulders, hands on his upper back, the head down on the brother's left shoulder (to his own right), shoulders heaving with relief; rocks with him (same phase)
an awkward, shy wave: the right hand only shoulder-high, small quick waggles, the left hand rubbing the back of his neck, a sheepish head tilt and shuffle of the feet

the grand king: hands on his hips, chin up, chest out; slow breathing that lifts the belly, weight shifts with a little belly wobble, looks down his nose to one side and the other, a self-satisfied nod
grand gestures: jaw in a booming rhythm (lip sync overrides it), the right arm sweeps out wide palm-up, then both arms open; head tilts back on the big words; belly bounces with the emphasis

asleep on his feet: eyes shut, mouth a little open, the head nods lower and lower in three sinking nods (each deeper, the body tipping forward and the knees going soft), then a jerk upright with the eyes popping open for a moment, and he drifts off again; snoring breaths lift the belly; arms hang heavy
wakes with a start: jumps straight up with both arms flung high, lands with a squash and the belly bouncing (damped wobble), then holds frozen in panic, hands up by his head, knees bent, eyes wide
hopeful: leans forward from the hips toward the person in front, the right hand held out palm-up, the left hand on his belly, eyebrows up (curious face), a small nod of the chin; holds leaning
overjoyed: three claps in front of his chest (above the belly), bouncing on his toes with the belly jiggling late, head tipped back laughing; then the arms swing open

takes the honour from his own neck (both hands to his collar, a lift), steps forward and places it on the head of the man 0.12 in front (hands at his head height, marker `on` = show joseph/nemes and collar), presses it down gently, steps back with the hands opening proudly, ends with hands clasped on his belly, beaming

a regal wave from his throne: the right hand raised at the shoulder, palm out, turning slowly at the wrist (a royal waggle), the left hand resting on the belly, chin up, a gracious small bow of the head
